name: Robotics TRIZ
description: Same TRIZ machinery with robotics / IoT / embedded vocabulary — actuators, sensors, autonomy, motion control, calibration and edge compute.

parameter_map.Speed: cycle time / joint velocity / control-loop rate
parameter_map.Measurement accuracy: sensor accuracy / localization error / encoder resolution
parameter_map.Loss of information: sensor noise / dropout / telemetry data loss
parameter_map.Duration of action of moving object: battery life / runtime / actuator duty cycle

principle_soft.1: segment the task — modular skills; split a grasp into sub-primitives
principle_soft.2: take the heavy compute off the robot — offload perception to the edge or server
principle_soft.3: local quality — per-joint control gains, zone-specific sensor tuning
principle_soft.10: pre-compute motion plans and pre-calibrate before the task starts
principle_soft.13: invert — treat the error as the signal; close the loop on the residual
principle_soft.15: dynamic control — adaptive gains, impedance control that stiffens on contact
principle_soft.24: intermediary — tool changer, sensor-fusion layer, shared memory buffer
principle_soft.35: change the state — switch control mode or firmware operating mode on demand

examples: The robot arm must move faster, but higher speed causes oscillation at the end effector.
The drone must fly longer, but adding battery capacity makes it heavier and drains more power.
The autonomous vehicle must react faster to obstacles, but the perception model is too slow on the edge hardware.
